consumption.method: Git dependency pinned by an exact revision published on the weholt/RapidRAW feature/lap-engine-extraction branch. Never a floating branch or an uncommitted path.
localReproduction: 1. Clone https://github.com/weholt/RapidRAW.git and fetch feature/lap-engine-extraction; the pinned revision is e43646df6e75aabc771bac72458c51e5aef7734a. The original C:/Users/Thomas/Desktop/RapidRAW checkout is not required for Lap builds.

2. To rebuild or extend the engine locally, use the rustup 1.98/MSVC toolchain and build the cloned feature branch. Engine changes require a new pinned revision and updated lock entry before Lap adopts them.

3. Lap src-tauri references rapidraw-develop and rapidraw-edit-model at the exact revision above; Cargo records the remote URL and rev in its lockfile. A network fetch is needed on a fresh machine, but no local engine path or model download is required.

4. Windows MAX_PATH caution: rawler's git checkout contains deeply nested testdata paths. A fresh dependency cache must live under a short path (the verification below used C:/Users/Thomas/.cg1, 20 characters, deleted afterwards); deeper CARGO_HOME roots fail cargo fetch with 'path too long'.
